grid_pattern.css: background-size: 40px 40px; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
grid_pattern.usage: Apply to the main background <body> or a fixed <div> behind content.

images.description: Abstract dark gradient for hero section background (optional overlay)

implementation_steps.details: Replace root variables with the new Deep Dark palette. Add the .bg-grid-pattern utility class.
Update typography to use 'Inter' with tight tracking. Add the radial gradient background to the body.
Modify the THEMES object to use the new #188455 primary color. Update the SidebarNav to use the new active states. Add the grid pattern background div.
Ensure cards support the new hover effects and border styles defined in design_system.components.cards.

universal_guidelines: Do not use pure black (#000000) for backgrounds; use #020617 or #0f172a.
Always add a subtle 1px border (border-white/5) to cards and sidebars to define edges in dark mode.
Use 'text-balance' on headlines for better optical alignment.
Ensure all interactive elements have a :focus-visible state with the primary green ring.
Use 'backdrop-blur' heavily on sticky elements (nav, sidebar) to create depth.
